body.statement: Along legal triangular arrays satisfying \(K=o(N^{q_d})\), use \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{frontier}}\) to determine explicit rate functions \(\rho_{\mathrm{est}}(N,K)\) and \(\rho_{\mathrm{len}}(N,K)\) such that \(R_d(N,K)\asymp\rho_{\mathrm{est}}(N,K)\) and \(E_{d,\alpha}(N,K)\asymp\rho_{\mathrm{len}}(N,K)\), including the exact fixed-\(K\) logarithms and every transition inside this remaining regime. The estimation converse must instantiate a simultaneous finite-support family whose endpoint separation matches \(\rho_{\mathrm{est}}\), whose hypothesis mixtures satisfy \(\operatorname{TV}_{\mathrm{mix}}\le1/4\), and whose reduced costs satisfy \(\mathfrak g_{\mathrm{rem}}\ge0\) for every alternative rematching. The expected-length converse must additionally order its low- and high-endpoint mixtures so that the same indistinguishability argument is one-sided. The upper branch must give a computable estimator and uniformly honest lower bound at the claimed rates, or replace the present \(K^{-1}m^{-2/d}\) term by a proved sharper aggregate jointly conjugate complexity bound.
body.justification: After removing the solved root-\(N\) region, the kernel is the exact estimation and ordered one-sided frontier along \(K=o(N^{q_d})\).
body.gap: Exact fixed-\(K\) logarithms, the missing arm factor, and every-rematching ordered separation remain unresolved.
body.consumer: A solution would complete the decision-theoretic account for every legal small-arm array.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine matching all-estimator and ordered one-sided lower bounds along \(K=o(N^{q_d})\), including the exact fixed-\(K\) logarithm and every transition inside that region.
obligation.obstruction: The available nonparametric converse is the embedded two-margin order \(K^{-2}(m\log m)^{-2/d}\), whereas the plug-in upper contribution is \(K^{-1}m^{-2/d}\). Neither an all-rematching simultaneous family nor a sharper aggregate upper theorem is available.
obligation.attempted: The exact residual cap, optimal-support diameter, empirical interpolation, two-margin reduction, Bernoulli ordered pair, dimension-dependent root-\(N\) theorems, and rational certified algorithm are complete. Sparse-arm, parity, and fixed-dimensional orthogonal constructions do not close the remaining gap.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved region and the remaining region are now separated explicitly. For every balanced array,
\[
c_d\max\left\{N^{-1/2},K^{-2}(m\log m)^{-2/d}\right\}
\le R_d(N,K)
\le C_d\left[N^{-1/2}+\min\left\{\frac r{K^2},\frac1K m^{-2/d}\right\}\right].
\]
Moreover,
\[
c_{d,\alpha}N^{-1/2}
\le E_{d,\alpha}(N,K)
\le C_{d,\alpha}\left[N^{-1/2}+\min\left\{\frac r{K^2},\frac1K m^{-2/d}\right\}\right],
\]
and the upper length bound is attained by the uniformly honest \(B_N^{\mathrm{plug}}\). Both decision risks are exactly of order \(N^{-1/2}\) whenever \(K\ge c_0N^{q_d}\), where \(q_5=1/6\) and \(q_d=1/4\) for \(d\ge6\). The rational-grid empirical MOT algorithm returns primal and dual certificates with any rational requested width \(\epsilon\) in time polynomial in \(N\) and \((K/\epsilon)^d\). What remains is the matching estimation and ordered one-sided converse, including fixed-\(K\) logarithms, along \(K=o(N^{q_d})\).
